audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[].side is exactly inverted from content win[]: full says Pyke wins levels 1-4 and Skill for 6/first-item/2+items, content says Skill for levels 1-5 and Pyke from 6 onward. The packet's own levelChart (Skill,Skill,Skill,Skill,Pyke,Pyke,Pyke) matches content, not full.
audit.why: Content whys[] are specific and match the packet chart exactly (even early lane, Pyke spikes at 6 with Death From Below resets and roam pressure). Full is the wrong layer here.
audit.corrected: Flipped all 7 phases[].side + why + rating to match content/packet.

audit.why: Spikes correctly name level 6 Death From Below execute-reset and the first-item roam-mobility spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two applicable interactions from missingInteractions are never stated: Gift of the Drowned Ones (P) bypasses raw HP stacking (Pyke gets bonus AD instead of max HP, so this is really about his own scaling, but the practical read is stacked resistances matter more than raw health versus his damage), and Ghostwater Dive (W) stealth has no reveal in the current text.
audit.why: Both are packet-flagged high-value gaps specific to this matchup, not generic advice.
audit.corrected: Added a resistances note to breakdown.early and a Control Ward note to report[8] itemization.

edits.after: Even level 1: stronger poke, but his grey-health passive keeps him safe.

edits.before: W-sustain begins: the duo shield-heal makes even trades dishonest.
edits.after: Skill-based: your Q-E trades match his Q harass and E stun threat.

edits.before: E-chains open: slow into root is the lane's longest pick.
edits.after: A wash: you out-poke but must respect his hook-stun all-in.

edits.before: Echo economy: bank the third cast for the moment that matters.
edits.after: Even trades continue as his roam pressure balances your lane control.

edits.before: Encore online — the charm extends through your team; fights start two screens early.
edits.after: Death From Below (R) executes low targets and resets — he snowballs off any kill.

edits.before: First item: echoed Qs chunk and the ledger compounds.
edits.after: His roam mobility cashes picks you can't match immobile.

edits.before: Late Seraphine conducts teamfights from the support slot — charm, echo, root, repeat.
edits.after: His Flash-R assassinations keep threatening your squishy backline at two items.

edits.before: Echoed Q the pair, W the trade-back, E the disengage — taxed, healed, and rooted in one verse.

edits.before: Spending the echo on a plain W off-rhythm — the third note is the champion.
edits.after: He resets off any kill with Death From Below — don't chase a low target alone.

edits.before: - Pyke Bone Skewer: matchup-defining — The hook starts the chain — his R cleans what it catches. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E Beat Drop banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Pyke Bone Skewer (Q): 10s at rank 1, down to 8s at max — the hook starts the chain, his R cleans what it catches. - Keep Beat Drop (E) banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.

edits.before: Sing the ledger — echoed pokes and duo sustain tilt even lanes quietly.
edits.after: His passive swaps HP for AD — raw health buys less safety than armor or MR.
